title: Run.ChangesApproved
description: The payload of an approval at a flow's step before its last (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.ChangesApproved): the step's work goes on to the next step, built on it, and nothing reaches the theatre yet. Its lineage carries the approval, troupe's in role troupe or a person's in the cue's role. Final: nothing else settles the run's changes after it.

lineage.description: Where the event came from. It names the performance the run is a step of.

role.description: The role that let the work go on: troupe, or the role the open cue was for.
